notes.text: Yoma 4b follows ד:. under the colon convention, with a terminal period; no named edition is independently verified.

Charash is a conventional vocalization of חרש. Tanna is Hyman’s parenthetical classification, preserved without treating it as evidence for an expanded personal title. The abbreviated title remains R'.
